summary: Fresh bounded review found one medium startup-cleanup reporting defect and one low malformed-wildcard configuration mismatch. Preflight focused suite passed all 48 tests; both findings have isolated reproductions. Subsequent affected rechecks confirm persistent cleanup failure is reported false, successful retry is reported true, and bracketed wildcards are rejected; original review and source identities are retained.
limitations: Bounded fresh first pass on the supplied working-tree snapshot at base a0fee8b5b4101a489163d499265c64d33ab51e11. Any subsequent edits require affected rechecks; this report preserves original findings and hashes.

No Docker daemon, external provider, localhost:8787, existing application data, full rehearsal, broad suite, hosted TLS, IAM, real IdP, remote recovery or capacity checks were executed. Cleanup fault injection used a built-in spawn stub; it demonstrates reporting/control flow, not Docker daemon behavior.

Lead-owned documentation was excluded because it was not stable. Existing dependencies were examined only where directly relevant to configuration interpretation, identity, startup/shutdown, resource lifetime and recovery verification.
No supported secret disclosure or backup-consistency defect was identified within the assigned bounded source review; absence of a finding is not a production-readiness claim.
